title: Pythagorean Timed Exercise
description: 1 captured save. One original BASIC player; historical bugs remain.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: Pythagorean timed exercise
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Ordered lines; consistent pointer base 17125; exact full length and end marker; byte-identical left/right recovery
versions.startupSource:
2 AT=100000
5 CLS:G(1)=2:G(2)=1
7 GOSUB 20000
10 READ X1,Y1,X2,Y2:IFX1=-1 THEN X1=OX:Y1=OY
15 IF X1=-999 THEN 100
30 OX=X2:OY=Y2
40 GOSUB1000
50 GOTO 10
100 PRINT@448+25+128+64,"PYTHAGOREAN";
110 IF INKEY$=""THEN110
120 CLS
130  S(1)=RND(10):S(2)=RND(10):M=RND(3):S(3)=RND(15-S(G(M)))+S(G(M)):IFM=3THENX=S(1)[2+S(2)[2ELSEX=S(3)[2-S(G(M))[2
